一位母亲去一家零售玩具店为她八岁的女儿购买生日礼物。一名玩具店员工未经检查，就将一个电动玩具烤箱卖给了这位母亲。这个玩具烤箱可以利用其内部灯泡产生的热量来烘烤少量真实食物。玩具烤箱附带的说明书明确指出，操作烤箱时需要有成人监护，因此这位母亲帮助女儿使用烤箱烤布朗尼蛋糕。在烤布朗尼蛋糕时，一个住在隔壁的六岁男孩过来和女儿一起玩耍。布朗尼蛋糕烤好后，母亲让这个男孩打开烤箱并取出蛋糕。就在他这么做的时候，烤箱内一个破碎的灯泡突然起火，导致男孩双手二度烧伤。

男孩的父亲随后对玩具烤箱的制造商提起了过失诉讼。在审判中，事实证明，如果制造商或玩具店在检查玩具烤箱时尽到了合理的注意义务，那个破碎的灯泡本应被发现。

谁可能胜诉？
options:
A. The boy's father, because the defect in the toy oven existed at the time it left the manufacturer's control.
男孩的父亲，因为玩具烤箱的缺陷在它离开制造商控制时就已经存在。

B. The boy's father, because the manufacturer breached its duty of reasonable care toward the boy.
男孩的父亲，因为制造商违反了其对男孩应尽的合理注意义务。

C. The manufacturer, because it was not reasonably foreseeable that the boy would be injured by the daughter's defective toy oven.
制造商，因为男孩会被女儿的有缺陷的玩具烤箱所伤，这一点是无法合理预见的。

D. The manufacturer, because the toy store's negligent failure to inspect the toy oven before selling it to the mother is a superseding cause of the boy's injuries.
制造商，因为玩具店在将玩具烤箱出售给母亲前，其过失未能检查的行为是导致男孩受伤的一个介入性替代原因。
data.explanation:
A commercial manufacturer, distributor, retailer, or seller of a product owes a duty of reasonable care to any foreseeable plaintiff (ie, purchaser, user, bystander). Failure to exercise reasonable care in the inspection or sale of a product constitutes a breach of that duty. If the breach causes the plaintiff physical harm (ie, personal injury or property damage), the plaintiff will prevail in a negligence action.

Here, the manufacturer owed a duty of reasonable care to the boy as a user of the toy oven because it was foreseeable that other children might play with the daughter's toy (Choice C). Had the manufacturer exercised reasonable care in the inspection of the oven, it would have discovered the broken light bulb and the boy would not have suffered second-degree burns. Therefore, the boy's father will prevail because the manufacturer breached its duty of reasonable care toward the boy and caused his injuries.

(Choice A) A strict products liability action requires proof that the product was defective, the defect existed when it left the defendant's control, and the defect caused the plaintiff's injuries. But here, the father filed a negligence action.

(Choice D) The toy store's failure to inspect the toy oven before selling it to the mother is not a superseding cause that would relieve the manufacturer of liability for the boy's harm. That is because the toy store's failure to inspect the toy oven was foreseeable.

Educational objective: Commercial manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and sellers of a product owe a duty of reasonable care to any foreseeable plaintiff (ie, purchaser, user, or bystander). The failure to exercise reasonable care in the inspection or sale of a product constitutes a breach of that duty.



选项正确率统计：A选项 51%，B选项 43%（正确选项），C选项 1%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

产品的商业制造商、分销商、零售商或销售商对任何可预见的诉讼原告（即购买者、使用者、旁观者）负有合理注意义务。在产品的检查或销售过程中未能尽到合理注意义务，即构成对该义务的违反。如果该违反对原告造成了身体伤害（即人身伤害或财产损失），原告将在过失诉讼中胜诉。

在本案中，制造商对作为玩具烤箱使用者的男孩负有合理注意义务，因为其他孩子可能会玩女儿的玩具是可预见的（选项C）。如果制造商在检查烤箱时尽到了合理注意义务，它本应发现破碎的灯泡，男孩也就不会遭受二度烧伤。因此，男孩的父亲将会胜诉，因为制造商违反了其对男孩的合理注意义务并导致了他的伤害。

（选项A）严格产品责任诉讼要求证明产品存在缺陷，该缺陷在产品离开被告控制时即已存在，并且该缺陷导致了原告的伤害。但在本案中，父亲提起的是过失诉讼。

（选项D）玩具店在将烤箱出售给母亲前未能进行检查，这并不构成一个可以免除制造商对男孩伤害所负责任的介入性替代原因。这是因为玩具店未能检查玩具烤箱的行为是可预见的。

教学目标：产品的商业制造商、分销商、零售商和销售商对任何可预见的诉讼原告（即购买者、使用者或旁观者）负有合理注意义务。在产品的检查或销售过程中未能尽到合理注意义务，即构成对该义务的违反。

References

Restatement (Third) of Torts: Prods. Liab. § 15 (Am. Law Inst. 1998) (failure to inspect product).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

产品责任：过失 (Negligence)
✅ 正确答案：B

男孩的父亲胜诉，因为制造商违反了其对男孩应尽的合理注意义务 (Breached its duty of reasonable care)。

法律依据与推理

本题的核心在于区分产品责任中的两种诉因：过失 (Negligence) 与 严格责任 (Strict Liability)。

1. 诉因的确定 (Cause of Action)
题目明确指出父亲提起的是“过失诉讼” (Negligence Action)。因此，我们必须应用过失侵权的四个要素进行分析：
  • Duty (义务)
  • Breach (违约/过失行为)
  • Causation (因果关系)
  • Damages (损害)
2. 义务与违反 (Duty & Breach)
根据著名的 MacPherson v. Buick Motor Co. 判例原则，制造商对所有可预见的原告 (Foreseeable Plaintiffs) 负有合理注意义务。

在本案中：
  • 义务：邻居小孩玩玩具是完全可预见的，因此制造商对该男孩负有义务。
  • 违反：题目事实部分已确认“如果制造商尽到合理注意义务进行检查，本应发现破损”。未能发现即证明了其在检查环节的过失 (Negligent Inspection)。
为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 A (陷阱选项)
虽然“缺陷在离开制造商控制时已存在”是事实，但这描述的是严格产品责任 (Strict Products Liability) 的构成要件，而不是过失诉讼的要件。在过失诉讼中，原告必须证明被告的行为“缺乏合理注意”，而不仅仅是产品有缺陷。
❌ 选项 C (不可预见)
法律认定产品的用户、旁观者（如邻居小孩）通常都是可预见的。制造商不能声称不知道小孩会和朋友一起玩玩具。
❌ 选项 D (介入原因)
中间商未能检查 (Retailer's failure to inspect) 通常被视为可预见的过失，因此它不是一个能切断制造商责任的“介入性替代原因” (Superseding Cause)。制造商不能通过指望零售商检查来推卸自己的检查义务。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
审题时务必圈出原告提起的诉讼类型！
如果题目说是 "Strict Liability Action"，选 A 可能正确。
但题目说是 "Negligence Action"，必须选包含 "Duty" 或 "Care" 字眼的选项 (即选项 B)。不要被事实正确的错误法律标准误导。

questions.question:
An amusement park purchased an oversized caricature mask from a manufacturer. One of the amusement park's employees was wearing the mask when she was accidentally tripped by a customer. The employee fell, injuring her neck from the strain caused by the weight of the mask. The employee filed a worker's compensation claim but only received limited compensation that did not cover the full cost of treating her injury.
The employee brought a negligence suit against the manufacturer and has established that, in designing the mask, the manufacturer failed to include a safety harness that would protect the wearer's neck from strain caused by a fall. In its defense, the manufacturer established that the mask's design complied with all government standards for flammability and composition, and that those standards did not require the masks to have safety harnesses.
Is the employee likely to be awarded damages from the manufacturer?

choices.a: No, because the employee's injury was caused by an intervening negligent act.
choices.b: No, because the manufacturer's compliance with safety standards is conclusive evidence that it was not negligent.
choices.c: Yes, because negligent intervening acts are generally regarded as foreseeable.
choices.d: Yes, because the manufacturer was a commercial seller of the mask.

In its defense, the manufacturer established that the mask's design complied with all government standards for flammability and composition, and that those standards did not require the masks to have safety harnesses.

Is the employee likely to be awarded damages from the manufacturer?

一家游乐园从一家制造商处购买了一个超大的卡通面具。该游乐园的一名员工在佩戴面具时，被一名顾客意外绊倒。该员工摔倒，因面具重量造成的拉力而伤及颈部。该员工提出了工伤赔偿索赔，但只获得了有限的赔偿，不足以支付其全部的治疗费用。

该员工对制造商提起了过失诉讼，并已证明，在设计面具时，制造商未能安装一个安全带以保护佩戴者的颈部免受因摔倒造成的拉伤。制造商在辩护中证明，该面具的设计符合所有关于易燃性和成分的政府标准，且这些标准并未要求面具必须配备安全带。

该员工是否有可能从制造商处获得损害赔偿金？
options:
A. No, because the employee's injury was caused by an intervening negligent act.
不会，因为该员工的伤害是由一个介入性过失行为造成的。

B. No, because the manufacturer's compliance with safety standards is conclusive evidence that it was not negligent.
不会，因为制造商符合安全标准是其没有过失的决定性证据。

C. Yes, because negligent intervening acts are generally regarded as foreseeable.
会，因为介入性过失行为通常被认为是可预见的。

D. Yes, because the manufacturer was a commercial seller of the mask.
会，因为制造商是该面具的商业销售者。
data.explanation:
A plaintiff harmed by a defective product can prevail in a negligence suit against a manufacturer (or other seller) by proving that the manufacturer's failure to use reasonable care actually and proximately caused the plaintiff's harm. An intervening act or event that contributed to the plaintiff's harm will not break the chain of causation and relieve the manufacturer from liability if that act or event was reasonably foreseeable.† And, as a general rule, negligent intervening acts are regarded as foreseeable.

Here, the employee sued the manufacturer of the mask after she fell and injured her neck from the strain caused by the weight of the mask. The manufacturer likely failed to use reasonable care in designing the mask without a safety harness to prevent this type of injury. And though a customer accidentally tripped the employee, causing her to fall, that intervening negligent act is regarded as foreseeable . Therefore, it did not cut off the manufacturer's liability, and the employee is likely to be awarded damages from the manufacturer (Choice A).

†By contrast, intervening acts or events that were NOT reasonably foreseeable become superseding causes that break the chain of causation between the defendant's tortious conduct and the plaintiff's harm.

(Choice B) Compliance with governmental safety standards is not conclusive evidence that a product was not defective or that the manufacturer was not negligent. However, a jury may consider whether a product complied with governmental safety standards when determining these issues.

(Choice D) Unlike a products liability action based in strict liability, an action based in negligence can be brought against a commercial or noncommercial seller. Therefore, the fact that the manufacturer was a commercial seller of the mask is irrelevant.

Educational objective: A products liability claim based in negligence requires proof that the defendant's (eg, manufacturer's) failure to use reasonable care caused the plaintiff's harm. An intervening act or event that contributed to the plaintiff's harm will NOT cut off the defendant's liablity if the act or event was reasonably foreseeable (eg, a negligent intervening act).



选项正确率统计：A选项 21%，B选项 10%，C选项 46%（正确选项），D选项 21%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

因缺陷产品而受到损害的原告，可以通过证明制造商未尽到合理注意义务的行为是造成其损害的实际原因和近因，而在针对制造商（或其他销售者）的过失诉讼中胜诉。如果导致原告损害的介入行为或事件是合理可预见的，那么该行为或事件将不会切断因果关系链，也无法免除制造商的责任。† 通常，介入性过失行为被认为是可预见的。

在本案中，该员工在摔倒并因面具重量的拉力而伤及颈部后，起诉了面具制造商。制造商在设计面具时，很可能未尽到合理注意义务，未能配备安全带以防止此类伤害的发生。尽管是一名顾客意外绊倒该员工致其摔倒，但该介入性过失行为被认为是可预见的。因此，该行为并未切断制造商的责任，该员工很可能从制造商处获得损害赔偿金（选项A）。

†相比之下，那些非合理可预见的介入行为或事件则成为取代性原因（superseding causes），会切断被告侵权行为与原告损害之间的因果关系链。

（选项B）符合政府安全标准并不是产品没有缺陷或制造商没有过失的决定性证据。但是，在裁定这些问题时，陪审团可以考虑产品是否符合政府安全标准。

（选项D）与基于严格责任的产品责任诉讼不同，基于过失的诉讼可以针对商业或非商业销售者提起。因此，制造商是该面具的商业销售者这一事实是无关紧要的。

教学目标：基于过失的产品责任索赔要求证明被告（如制造商）未尽到合理注意义务的行为造成了原告的损害。导致原告损害的介入行为或事件，如果该行为或事件是合理可预见的（例如，介入性过失行为），则不会切断被告的责任。

References

Restatement (Third) of Torts: Liab. for Physical & Emotional Harm § 6 (Am. Law Inst. 2010) (negligence liability).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

侵权法：产品责任与因果关系
正确答案：C 是的，因为介入性过失行为通常被认为是可预见的。
核心法律规则

本题考查的是过失侵权（Negligence）中的近因（Proximate Cause）和介入行为（Intervening Acts）。

在产品责任的过失诉讼中，原告必须证明被告的行为是造成伤害的“近因”。

关键规则：如果一个第三方的介入行为（即使是过失行为）是合理可预见的（Reasonably Foreseeable），那么它不会切断被告的责任链条。

案情逻辑分析

1. 过失（Breach of Duty）： 原告已经证明制造商在设计面具时未包含安全带（Safety Harness），这构成了设计上的缺乏合理注意。

2. 介入行为（Intervening Act）： 顾客意外绊倒员工，导致员工摔倒。这是一个第三方的过失行为。

3. 可预见性（Foreseeability）： 在游乐园这种拥挤的环境中，佩戴视线受阻或笨重面具的人被绊倒或摔倒是高度可预见的。

4. 结论： 既然摔倒是可预见的，制造商就有义务设计产品以减轻摔倒带来的伤害（如安装安全带）。顾客的绊倒行为虽然是介入因素，但因为它是可预见的，所以它不是取代性原因（Superseding Cause），制造商仍需负责。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A 错误

理由：它错误地认为任何介入性过失都会切断责任。法律规定，只有不可预见（Unforeseeable）的介入行为才会切断因果关系链。

选项 B 错误

理由：这是一个经典的 MBE 陷阱。符合政府标准（Compliance with Statutes）只是证明被告尽到了注意义务的证据（Evidence），但不是决定性的（Conclusive）。陪审团仍可以认定，尽管符合标准，该设计在普通法下仍是不合理的。

选项 D 错误

理由：虽然“商业销售者”身份在严格产品责任（Strict Products Liability）中至关重要，但本题是过失（Negligence）诉讼。在过失诉讼中，核心是“注意义务”和“因果关系”，而不是销售者的商业身份。此外，这个选项没有回应题目中关于“介入行为”的核心抗辩。

MBE 考试技巧

区分 Negligence 和 Strict Liability：

  • 看到 Negligence（过失）诉讼，重点找 Duty, Breach, Causation。
  • 看到 Strict Liability（严格责任），重点找 Defect（缺陷）和 Commercial Seller（商业销售者）。

关于因果关系： 永远问自己“这个意外发生的方式是否令人惊讶？”如果仅仅是普通的过失（如绊倒、车祸、医疗事故），通常都是可预见的，不会切断被告的责任。

questions.question:
A window manufacturer made windows for a commercial skyscraper. The manufacturer made the windows in strict accordance with the specifications provided by the general contractor for the building and used reasonable care in making the windows. Nevertheless, a defect in the design of the windows resulted in one of the windows suddenly shattering and injuring an office worker who sat next to the window in the completed building.
Is the office worker likely to recover damages in an action against the manufacturer based solely on strict products liability?

choices.a: No, because the manufacturer strictly adhered to the specifications provided.
choices.b: No, because the windows' defective design was attributable to the general contractor's negligence.
choices.c: Yes, because the manufacturer was in privity with the general contractor.
choices.d: Yes, because the office worker was injured by the defective window.

一家窗户制造商为一栋商业摩天大楼制造窗户。该制造商严格按照大楼总承包商提供的规格制造窗户，并在制造过程中尽到了合理的注意义务。然而，窗户的设计缺陷导致其中一扇窗户突然破碎，伤害了在大楼建成后坐在窗边的一名办公室职员。

该办公室职员仅基于严格产品责任（strict products liability）对制造商提起诉讼，是否可能获得损害赔偿？
options:
A. No, because the manufacturer strictly adhered to the specifications provided.
不会，因为制造商严格遵守了所提供的规格。

B. No, because the windows' defective design was attributable to the general contractor's negligence.
不会，因为窗户的设计缺陷可归因于总承包商的疏忽。

C. Yes, because the manufacturer was in privity with the general contractor.
会，因为制造商与总承包商有直接合同关系。

D. Yes, because the office worker was injured by the defective window.
会，因为该办公室职员被有缺陷的窗户所伤。
data.explanation:
To recover in an action based on strict products liability , the plaintiff must prove the following elements:

The defendant was a commercial seller (eg, manufacturer - as seen here).† The product was defective when it left the defendant's control. The defect caused the plaintiff physical harm (ie, bodily harm or property damage).

Here, there was a defect in the design of the windows, which necessarily existed when the windows left the manufacturer's control. That defect resulted in one of the windows suddenly shattering and injuring the office worker. Therefore, the office worker is likely to recover damages in an action against the manufacturer based on strict products liability.

†A commercial seller does not include someone who makes casual or occasional sales that are not part of his/her regular business (eg, an individual car owner who sells a car to his neighbor).

(Choices A & B) The manufacturer's strict adherence to the specifications provided by the general contractor shows that the windows' defective design was attributable to the general contractor. But strict products liability is imposed on commercial sellers without proof of fault (eg, negligence) - even if the seller did not create the defect - so long as the defect existed at the time it left the seller's control (as seen with the manufacturer here).

(Choice C) Although the manufacturer and the general contractor were in privity, privity is not a requirement in a strict liability action. Additionally, even if privity were a requirement, it would be based on the relationship of the manufacturer (as defendant) and the office worker (as plaintiff) - not the manufacturer and the general contractor.

Educational objective: A strict products liability claim requires proof that:
  • the defendant was a commercial seller,
  • the product was defective when it left the defendant's control, and
  • the defect caused the plaintiff physical harm.




选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 4%，C选项 8%，D选项 80%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

要在基于严格产品责任 (strict products liability) 的诉讼中获得赔偿，原告必须证明以下要素：

被告是商业销售者（例如，本案中的制造商）。† 产品在离开被告控制时存在缺陷。该缺陷对原告造成了人身伤害（即身体伤害或财产损失）。

在本案中，窗户的设计存在缺陷，该缺陷在窗户离开制造商控制时必然存在。该缺陷导致其中一扇窗户突然破碎并伤害了该办公室职员。因此，该办公室职员很可能在基于严格产品责任对制造商提起的诉讼中获得损害赔偿。

†商业销售者不包括那些非其常规业务范围内的偶然或临时销售者（例如，个人车主向其邻居出售一辆汽车）。

（选项 A 和 B）制造商严格遵守总承包商提供的规格，表明窗户的设计缺陷可归因于总承包商。但是，严格产品责任被施加于商业销售者，无需证明其存在过错（例如，疏忽）——即使销售者并未造成该缺陷——只要该缺陷在产品离开销售者控制时已经存在（如此处的制造商）。

（选项 C）尽管制造商和总承包商之间有直接合同关系（privity），但直接合同关系并非严格责任诉讼的要件。此外，即使直接合同关系是一个要件，它也应基于制造商（作为被告）和办公室职员（作为原告）之间的关系——而非制造商和总承包商之间的关系。

教学目标：一项严格产品责任索赔要求证明：
  • 被告是商业销售者，
  • 产品在离开被告控制时存在缺陷，以及
  • 该缺陷对原告造成了人身伤害。


References

Restatement (Third) of Torts: Prods. Liab. §§ 1, 2(b) (Am. Law Inst. 1998) (liability for products that are defective in design).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Strict Products Liability (严格产品责任)
✅ 正确答案：D
因为办公室职员被有缺陷的窗户所伤，且该窗户由作为商业销售者的制造商生产。
核心法则 (The Rule)

在严格产品责任 (Strict Products Liability) 诉讼中，原告只需证明以下三点即可胜诉，无需证明被告有过失 (Negligence)：

  1. 被告是该产品的商业销售者 (Commercial Seller/Manufacturer)。
  2. 产品在离开被告控制时存在缺陷 (Defective)。
  3. 该缺陷对原告造成了人身伤害或财产损失 (Causation & Damages)。
🔍 考点深度解析
👉
严格责任 vs. 疏忽 (Strict Liability vs. Negligence)
这是本题最大的陷阱。题目特意强调制造商“严格按照规格”且“尽到了合理的注意义务 (used reasonable care)”。

如果是疏忽 (Negligence) 诉讼，这些事实是完美的抗辩理由。但在严格责任下，被告的行为是否小心谨慎无关紧要。只要产品有缺陷且造成了伤害，制造商就必须负责。
🏭
供应链责任 (Chain of Distribution)
制造商将有缺陷的产品投入商业流转。即使设计缺陷源于总承包商的图纸，制造商作为制造并销售该产品的商业主体，仍需对最终用户承担严格责任。制造商可以在赔偿后向总承包商追偿 (Indemnification)，但这不影响其对原告的责任。
🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A & B (关注注意义务/规格)
错误。这两个选项都在讨论“过错”或“疏忽”的问题。虽然制造商没有疏忽（因为遵守了规格），但这不能免除严格责任。严格责任关注的是产品本身的状态，而不是被告的行为。
选项 C (关注合同关系/Privity)
错误。直接合同关系 (Privity of Contract) 早已不再是侵权法（无论是疏忽还是严格责任）的要件。任何可预见的受害者（如本案中的办公室职员）都可以起诉，无论他们是否直接购买了该产品。
💡 MBE 提分技巧
看到 "Strict Liability" 的题干时，请立即在脑海中划掉 "Reasonable Care" (合理注意) 和 "Intent" (意图) 相关的选项。

记住口诀：Strict means Strict. (严格就是严格)。只要是商业卖家卖出的缺陷产品伤了人，无论他多么小心，都要赔钱。

questions.question:
A cell phone manufacturer purchased batteries from a battery manufacturer for use in its cell phones. The batteries were defectively designed. The cell phone manufacturer was aware of the defect in the batteries but nevertheless sold the cell phones directly to consumers without any warning regarding this problem. The defect caused the cell phones to function only when plugged into a charger, greatly diminishing their use and value. However, no consumer was injured, and no property damage was sustained, as a result of the defective batteries.
Consumers whose cell phones were adversely affected by the defect in the batteries brought a class action lawsuit against the cell phone manufacturer based in negligence. The consumers now seek replacement of their cell phone batteries.
Assuming that the consumers can clear the procedural hurdles for bringing a class action lawsuit, are they likely to succeed?

choices.a: No, because the batteries are defective component parts and, therefore, the battery manufacturer is the liable party.
choices.b: No, because the consumers cannot recover for a purely economic loss.
choices.c: Yes, because the batteries were defective.
choices.d: Yes, because the cell phone manufacturer failed to warn the consumers about the defective batteries despite being aware of the defect.

questions.question:
A homeowner was injured when an automatic cutoff switch failed to function on a snowblower he was using. The cutoff switch had functioned well for a year after he purchased the snowblower but failed after the machine had been improperly repaired by a mechanic. The snowblower's operating manual contained a clear and prominent warning against making the very alteration to the switch mechanism that was made by the mechanic. The mechanic, however, did not have a manual available when he repaired the snowblower.
Does the homeowner have a viable claim against the manufacturer of the snowblower for damages?

choices.a: No, because the homeowner was contributorily negligent in failing to furnish the snowblower's manual to the mechanic.
choices.b: No, because the injury resulted from a substantial alteration of the snowblower by a third party.
choices.c: Yes, because a defect in the snowblower caused the homeowner's injury.
choices.d: Yes, because the manufacturer should have made the manual available to repair personnel.

data.questionStem:
Q83801 A homeowner was injured when an automatic cutoff switch failed to function on a snowblower he was using. The cutoff switch had functioned well for a year after he purchased the snowblower but failed after the machine had been improperly repaired by a mechanic. The snowblower's operating manual contained a clear and prominent warning against making the very alteration to the switch mechanism that was made by the mechanic. The mechanic, however, did not have a manual available when he repaired the snowblower.

Does the homeowner have a viable claim against the manufacturer of the snowblower for damages? 一名房主在使用除雪机时，因自动切断开关失灵而受伤。在他购买除雪机后的一年里，该切断开关一直运行良好，但在经过一名机修工的不当修理后失灵。除雪机的操作手册中包含一个清晰且醒目的警告，禁止对开关装置进行机修工所做的那种改动。然而，该机修工在修理除雪机时并没有手册可供参考。

该房主是否有理由向除雪机制造商提出损害赔偿的索赔？
options:
A. No, because the homeowner was contributorily negligent in failing to furnish the snowblower's manual to the mechanic.
没有，因为房主未能向机修工提供除雪机的手册，构成与有过失。

B. No, because the injury resulted from a substantial alteration of the snowblower by a third party.
没有，因为伤害是由第三方对除雪机进行实质性改变所导致的。

C. Yes, because a defect in the snowblower caused the homeowner's injury.
有，因为除雪机的缺陷导致了房主的伤害。

D. Yes, because the manufacturer should have made the manual available to repair personnel.
有，因为制造商本应向维修人员提供该手册。
data.explanation:
When a product poses a foreseeable risk of harm (eg, injury resulting from an unsafe repair), commercial suppliers must provide reasonable warnings or instructions if doing so would reduce that risk. Failure to provide adequate warnings or instructions renders the product defective and subjects commercial suppliers to strict products liability.

Here, the homeowner's injury occurred when his snowblower's automatic cutoff switch failed due to the mechanic's improper repair (foreseeable risk). But since the manufacturer provided a clear and prominent warning about that very alteration in the operating manual (reasonable warning) and there is no evidence that the snowblower was otherwise defective, the manufacturer is not liable for the homeowner's damages (Choice C).

(Choice A) Contributory negligence occurs when a plaintiff fails to use reasonable care for his/her own protection. Here, the homeowner was not contributorily negligent in failing to furnish the manual to the mechanic because the homeowner could reasonably rely on the mechanic's expertise.

(Choice D) A commercial supplier is only required to provide reasonable warnings or instructions. Here, the manufacturer could not identify every repair person who might work on its snowblowers, so it would be unreasonable to impose strict liability on the manufacturer for failing to provide a manual to the mechanic.

Educational objective: To avoid strict products liability, a commercial seller must provide reasonable warnings or instructions regarding any foreseeable risk of harm posed by its product if doing so will reduce that risk. Failure to provide adequate warnings or instructions renders the product defective.

Product defects caused by design or inadequate warnings/instructions


StepQuestionYes PathNo Path
1Product (as designed) poses foreseeable risk of harm?Proceed to Step 2No defect
2Feasible alternative design could reduce that risk?Design defectProceed to Step 3
3Reasonable warnings/instructions could reduce that risk?Inadequate warnings/instructionsNo defect




当一个产品构成可预见的伤害风险（例如，因不安全维修造成的伤害）时，如果提供合理的警告或说明能够降低该风险，则商业供应商必须提供。未能提供充分的警告或说明会使产品存在缺陷，并使商业供应商承担严格产品责任。

在此案中，房主的伤害发生在其除雪机的自动切断开关因机修工的不当修理（可预见的风险）而失灵时。但由于制造商在操作手册中针对此种改动提供了清晰且醒目的警告（合理的警告），并且没有证据表明除雪机在其他方面存在缺陷，因此制造商对房主的损害不承担责任（选项C）。

(选项A) 与有过失是指原告未能为保护自身而尽到合理注意。在此案中，房主未能向机修工提供手册并不构成与有过失，因为房主可以合理地依赖机修工的专业知识。

(选项D) 商业供应商仅被要求提供合理的警告或说明。在此案中，制造商无法识别出每一位可能维修其除雪机的维修人员，因此，因制造商未能向该机修工提供手册而对其施加严格责任是不合理的。

教学目标： 为避免严格产品责任，商业销售商必须就其产品构成的任何可预见的伤害风险提供合理的警告或说明，前提是这样做会降低该风险。未能提供充分的警告或说明会使产品存在缺陷。

因设计或警告/说明不充分导致的产品缺陷


步骤问题“是”的路径“否”的路径
1产品（按其设计）是否构成可预见的伤害风险？进入步骤2无缺陷
2可行的替代设计是否能降低该风险？设计缺陷进入步骤3
3合理的警告/说明是否能降低该风险？警告/说明不充分无缺陷


References
Restatement (Third) of Torts: Prods. Liab. § 2 (Am. Law Inst. 1998) (product defective due to the lack of reasonable warnings or instructions).

MBE 侵权法考点解析

Strict Products Liability & Substantial Alteration
正确答案：B
没有理由索赔，因为伤害是由第三方对除雪机进行实质性改变所导致的。

⚖️ 核心法律逻辑

严格产品责任 实质性改变

本题考查的是严格产品责任 (Strict Products Liability) 中的责任限制。要让制造商承担严格责任，原告必须证明以下几点：

  1. 被告是该产品的商业销售商 (Commercial Supplier)。
  2. 产品在离开被告控制时存在缺陷 (Defect)。
  3. 该缺陷是造成原告伤害的实际原因和近因。
  4. 产品在到达用户手中时，未发生实质性改变 (Substantial Change/Alteration)。

本案关键点分析：

  • 产品本身无缺陷： 除雪机在出售时是完好的，且包含了一个清晰、醒目的警告 (Warning)，明确禁止进行该种改装。因此，不存在制造缺陷 (Manufacturing Defect) 或警告缺陷 (Failure to Warn)。
  • 实质性改变： 伤害的直接原因是机修工 (Mechanic) 的不当修理。这种修理构成了对产品的实质性改变。
  • 因果关系中断： 当第三方的改动（尤其是制造商已明确警告禁止的改动）成为伤害的主要原因时，制造商不承担责任。

❌ 干扰项排除

选项 A (与有过失) 错误：
首先，在严格产品责任案件中，普通的共同过失 (Ordinary Contributory Negligence) 通常不是抗辩理由。其次，房主依赖专业机修工进行维修是合理的，不构成过失。

选项 C (存在缺陷) 错误：
这是最具迷惑性的选项。虽然房主确实因机器故障受伤，但该故障并非源于产品出厂时的缺陷，而是源于后来的不当维修。严格责任的前提是产品在离开制造商控制时就已经存在缺陷。

选项 D (提供手册义务) 错误：
法律只要求制造商采取合理 (Reasonable) 的措施来提供警告。将手册提供给购买者（房主）并包含醒目警告通常已被视为合理。要求制造商确保每一个可能接触机器的维修人员都能看到手册，施加了不切实际的过重负担。

🎓 MBE 考试锦囊

"Time of Sale" 原则：

在处理严格产品责任 (Strict Products Liability) 题目时，务必检查缺陷产生的时间点。如果产品在销售时 (Time of Sale) 是安全的，且包含了充分的警告，那么制造商通常不对后续因第三方实质性改动 (Substantial Alteration) 或不可预见的误用 (Unforeseeable Misuse) 造成的伤害负责。

注意区分： 如果改动是可预见的 (Foreseeable)，且制造商未能提供警告，则可能仍需负责。但在本题中，制造商已经提供了明确的警告，这足以免责。

questions.question:
A shop operates an aircraft supply business serving the needs of owners of private airplanes. A pilot contracted with the shop to replace the engine in his plane with a more powerful engine manufactured by an engine company. The shop purchased the replacement engine through a representative of the engine company and sold it to the pilot. A short time after it was put into use, the new engine failed, and the plane crashed into a warehouse owned by a woman, destroying the warehouse and its contents.
The shop was guilty of no negligence in the procurement or inspection of the engine. The failure of the engine was caused by a manufacturing defect that would not be disclosed by inspection and testing procedures available to a supplier. There was also no negligence on the part of the pilot in the installation of the engine or the piloting of the plane.
The woman recovered a judgment for damages from the shop for the destruction of her warehouse and its contents, and the shop has asserted a claim against the engine company to recover compensation on account of that liability.
In that action, what amount of compensation will the shop most likely recover?

choices.a: No compensation, because the shop sold the engine to the pilot.
choices.b: No compensation, because the woman's judgment established the shop's responsibility to the woman.
choices.c: Contribution only, because the shop and the engine company were equally innocent.
choices.d: Full compensation, because the engine was defective.

data.questionStem:
Q83205

A shop operates an aircraft supply business serving the needs of owners of private airplanes. A pilot contracted with the shop to replace the engine in his plane with a more powerful engine manufactured by an engine company. The shop purchased the replacement engine through a representative of the engine company and sold it to the pilot. A short time after it was put into use, the new engine failed, and the plane crashed into a warehouse owned by a woman, destroying the warehouse and its contents.

The shop was guilty of no negligence in the procurement or inspection of the engine. The failure of the engine was caused by a manufacturing defect that would not be disclosed by inspection and testing procedures available to a supplier. There was also no negligence on the part of the pilot in the installation of the engine or the piloting of the plane.

The woman recovered a judgment for damages from the shop for the destruction of her warehouse and its contents, and the shop has asserted a claim against the engine company to recover compensation on account of that liability.

In that action, what amount of compensation will the shop most likely recover?

一家店铺经营航空用品业务，为私人飞机的所有者提供服务。一名飞行员与该店铺签订合同，要求将他飞机上的发动机更换为一家发动机公司制造的更强大的发动机。该店铺通过发动机公司的代表购买了替换发动机，并将其出售给飞行员。在投入使用后不久，新发动机发生故障，飞机坠入一名女士所有的仓库，摧毁了仓库及其中的物品。

该店铺在采购或检查发动机方面没有过失。发动机的故障是由制造缺陷引起的，该缺陷无法通过供应商可用的检查和测试程序发现。飞行员在安装发动机或驾驶飞机方面也没有过失。

该女士因其仓库及物品被毁而从该店铺获得了损害赔偿的判决，该店铺已向发动机公司提出索赔，以就该责任获得补偿。

在该诉讼中，该店铺最有可能获得多少赔偿？
options:
A. No compensation, because the shop sold the engine to the pilot.
无赔偿，因为店铺将发动机卖给了飞行员。

B. No compensation, because the woman's judgment established the shop's responsibility to the woman.
无赔偿，因为女士获得的判决确立了店铺对她的责任。

C. Contribution only, because the shop and the engine company were equally innocent.
仅可获得分摊赔偿，因为店铺和发动机公司同样没有过错。

D. Full compensation, because the engine was defective.
全额赔偿，因为发动机存在缺陷。
data.explanation:
Any commercial supplier along the chain of distribution may be strictly liable for physical harm caused by a product's manufacturing defect that existed when the product left the supplier's control. However, commercial suppliers who did not negligently, recklessly, or intentionally fail to discover the product defect (ie, no independent culpability ) can seek indemnity (ie, full compensation) from commercial suppliers earlier in the chain of distribution.

Here, the woman recovered a judgment against the shop (retailer) because it sold the pilot a defective engine that caused his plane to crash into her warehouse (physical harm). But since the shop was not negligent in failing to discover the engine defect, it was not independently culpable. Therefore, the shop can recover full compensation from an earlier commercial supplier - the engine company (manufacturer).

(Choice A) Although the shop is subject to strict products liability because it sold the defective engine to the pilot, it can still recover full compensation (indemnity) from the engine company because it was not independently culpable.

(Choice B) The judgment establishing the shop's responsibility to the woman does not prevent the shop from recovering full compensation from the engine company since the judgment did not address whether the shop negligently, recklessly, or intentionally failed to discover the engine defect (independent culpability). But if the shop had been found independently culpable, the judgment would have precluded its indemnity claim.

(Choice C) Contribution allows one independently culpable commercial seller to recover the proportional share of damages attributable to another independently culpable commercial seller (eg, if a negligent retailer pays 100% of an injured party's claim but is only 60% at fault, it can recover 40% from the negligent manufacturer). But since the shop was not independently culpable, it can recover full compensation (indemnity) - not just a share (contribution).

Educational objective: Although any commercial supplier in the chain of distribution may be subject to strict products liability, suppliers who did not negligently, recklessly, or intentionally fail to discover the product defect (no independent culpability) can recover full compensation (indemnity) from suppliers earlier in the distribution chain.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 2%，C选项 7%，D选项 84%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

分销链中的任何商业供应商，对于产品离开其控制时就存在的制造缺陷所造成的有形损害，都可能承担严格责任。然而，对于产品缺陷的发现没有过失、鲁莽或故意的商业供应商（即无独立过错），可以向分销链上游的商业供应商寻求补偿（即全额赔偿）。

在本案中，该女士获得了对店铺（零售商）的胜诉判决，因为店铺向飞行员出售了一台有缺陷的发动机，导致其飞机坠入她的仓库（有形损害）。但由于店铺在未能发现发动机缺陷方面没有过失，因此它没有独立过错。因此，店铺可以从更上游的商业供应商——发动机公司（制造商）——那里获得全额赔偿。

(选项A) 尽管店铺因向飞行员出售有缺陷的发动机而需承担严格产品责任，但由于其没有独立过错，它仍然可以从发动机公司获得全额赔偿（补偿）。

(选项B) 确立店铺对该女士责任的判决，并不妨碍店铺从发动机公司获得全额赔偿，因为该判决并未涉及店铺是否存在过失、鲁莽或故意未能发现发动机缺陷（独立过错）的问题。但如果店铺被认定具有独立过错，该判决将使其无法提出补偿请求。

(选项C) 分摊赔偿允许一个有独立过错的商业销售商向另一个有独立过错的商业销售商追偿其应承担的损害赔偿比例份额（例如，如果一个有过失的零售商支付了受害方100%的索赔，但其过错程度仅为60%，则它可以向有过失的制造商追偿40%）。但由于该店铺没有独立过错，它可以获得全额赔偿（补偿）——而不仅仅是部分份额（分摊赔偿）。

教学目标：尽管分销链中的任何商业供应商都可能需要承担严格产品责任，但那些在发现产品缺陷方面没有过失、鲁莽或故意行为的供应商（无独立过错），可以向分销链上游的供应商要求全额赔偿（补偿）。

References

Restatement (Third) of Torts: Apportionment of Liab. § 22 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (indemnity).

Restatement (Third) of Torts: Prods. Liab. §§ 1, 2(a) (Am. Law Inst. 1998) (strict products liability for manufacturing defects).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Strict Liability & Indemnity
严格责任与全额赔偿
💡 核心法律原则 在严格产品责任（Strict Products Liability）中，如果处于分销链下游的零售商（Retailer）本身没有过失（No Negligence），仅因法律规定而对消费者承担责任，它可以向制造缺陷的上游制造商（Manufacturer）寻求全额赔偿（Indemnity）。
责任流向图解
制造商 (Engine Company)
制造了缺陷 (Active Fault)
↓
全额赔偿 (Indemnity)
↑
店铺 (Shop/Retailer)
无过失，但承担严格责任 (Passive Fault)
↓
严格责任赔偿 (Strict Liability)
受害人 (Woman)
获得判决赔偿
为什么选 D (Full Compensation)?

本题的关键在于区分Indemnity（全额赔偿/补偿）与Contribution（分摊）。

1. 店铺的责任： 店铺作为商业分销链（Chain of Distribution）的一环，对销售有缺陷的产品承担严格责任。因此，受害女士赢得了对店铺的诉讼。

2. 店铺的清白： 题目明确指出店铺在采购和检查中"guilty of no negligence"（没有过失），且缺陷无法通过常规检查发现。这意味着店铺承担的是一种替代责任或纯粹的法律责任，而非基于其自身的不当行为。

3. 赔偿规则： 当被告仅因法律政策（如严格责任）而承担责任，且自身没有独立过错（Independent Culpability）时，它有权向实际造成缺陷的一方（制造商）要求Indemnity。Indemnity 意味着将 100% 的损失转移给主要责任人。

干扰项排除
选项 A 错误 无赔偿： 仅仅因为店铺把引擎卖给了飞行员并不免除制造商对店铺的赔偿责任。分销链下游有权向上游追偿。
选项 B 错误 既判力误区： 店铺对女士的赔偿判决是基于“严格责任”，并不代表店铺有过失。这不影响店铺向制造商追偿。
选项 C 错误 Contribution (分摊)： 这是一个高频干扰项。Contribution 适用于共同过失（Joint Negligence）的情况，即双方都有错，按比例分担。但在本案中，店铺没有过失，因此适用的是 Indemnity（全额），而不是 Contribution（部分）。
🎓 MBE 备考技巧：
看到 "Retailer"（零售商）起诉 "Manufacturer"（制造商）的题目时，立即检查零售商是否有过失：
  • 如果零售商有过失（如未进行必要的检查）→ 适用 Contribution（分摊）。
  • 如果零售商无过失（仅承担严格责任）→ 适用 Indemnity（全额赔偿）。

questions.question:
A 16-year-old student purchased an educational chemistry set manufactured by a chemical company.
The student invited his classmate to assist him in a chemistry project. Referring to a website on explosives and finding that the chemistry set contained all of the necessary chemicals, the student and classmate agreed to make a bomb. During the course of the project, the student carelessly knocked a lighted Bunsen burner into a bowl of chemicals from the chemistry set. The chemicals burst into flames, injuring the classmate.
In a suit by the classmate against the chemical company based on strict liability, will the classmate likely prevail?

choices.a: No, because the student's negligence was the cause in fact of the classmate's injury.
choices.b: No, if the chemistry set was as safe as possible, consistent with its educational purposes, and its benefits exceeded its risks.
choices.c: Yes, because manufacturers of chemistry sets are engaged in an abnormally dangerous activity.
choices.d: Yes, if the chemistry set did not contain a warning that its contents could be combined to form dangerous explosives.

一名16岁的学生购买了一套由一家化学公司生产的教学用化学实验套装。

该学生邀请他的同学协助他完成一个化学项目。在查阅了一个关于炸药的网站后，发现该化学实验套装包含所有必要的化学品，该学生和同学同意制造一枚炸弹。在项目进行过程中，该学生不慎将一个点燃的本生灯撞入一个装有化学实验套装中化学品的碗里。化学品突然起火，导致同学受伤。

在该同学以严格责任为由对该化学公司提起的诉讼中，该同学是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the student's negligence was the cause in fact of the classmate's injury.
不会，因为该学生的过失是造成其同学受伤的事实原因。

B. No, if the chemistry set was as safe as possible, consistent with its educational purposes, and its benefits exceeded its risks.
不会，如果该化学实验套装在与其教学目的相符的情况下已尽可能安全，并且其益处超过其风险。

C. Yes, because manufacturers of chemistry sets are engaged in an abnormally dangerous activity.
会，因为化学实验套装的制造商从事的是一项极端危险的活动。

D. Yes, if the chemistry set did not contain a warning that its contents could be combined to form dangerous explosives.
会，如果该化学实验套装没有包含警告，说明其内容物可以混合制成危险的爆炸物。
data.explanation:
A commercial supplier is subject to strict products liability for harm caused by its defective product. A product is defective by design if:
  • it poses a foreseeable risk of harm and
  • that risk could have been reduced by a feasible alternative design (ie, the risk-utility test - comparing the risks and benefits of the original design to those of an alternative design).
Here, it may have been foreseeable that the chemistry set would be used in a harmful manner (to make a bomb). But if the chemistry set was as safe as possible, consistent with its educational purposes, and its benefits exceeded its risks, then the benefits of its original design would surpass those of an alternative design. In that case, the chemistry set would not be defective and the chemical company would not be strictly liable.

(Choice A) A "cause in fact" is an event that plays such a substantial role in causing the plaintiff's injury that the injury would not have occurred but for that event. But here, the classmate cannot prevail - regardless of whether the student's negligence was a cause in fact of the classmate's injury - because the chemistry set was not defective.

(Choice C) Strict liability may be imposed for harm caused by an abnormally dangerous activity. Although it may be abnormally dangerous to manufacture chemistry sets, the classmate was harmed by his attempt to make a bomb with a chemistry set - not by the chemical company's earlier manufacturing of that set. Therefore, the company is not liable under this theory.

(Choice D) Commercial suppliers may be strictly liable for not providing adequate warnings about a product's risk of harm - but only if those warnings would have prevented the plaintiff's harm. Here, the student and the classmate already knew (from the website) that the chemicals could be combined to make explosives and knowingly ignored that risk. Therefore, a warning would have been ineffective and a failure to warn claim would likely fail.

Educational objective: A product is defectively designed if (1) it poses a foreseeable risk of harm and (2) that risk could have been reduced by a feasible alternative design, as determined by the risk-utility test (comparing the risks and benefits of the original and alternative designs).



选项正确率统计：A选项 24%，B选项 32%（正确选项），C选项 7%，D选项 35%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

商业供应商需对其有缺陷产品造成的损害承担严格产品责任（strict products liability）。一个产品存在设计缺陷（defective by design），如果：
  • 它造成了可预见的损害风险 并且
  • 该风险本可以通过可行的替代设计来降低（即风险-效用测试(risk-utility test)——比较原始设计与替代设计的风险和益处）。
在本案中，化学实验套装将被以有害的方式（用于制造炸弹）使用，这可能是可预见的。但是，如果该化学实验套装在与其教学目的相符的情况下已尽可能安全，并且其益处超过其风险，那么其原始设计的益处将超过替代设计的益处。在这种情况下，该化学实验套装将不被视为有缺陷，化学公司也无需承担严格责任。

（选项 A）“事实原因”（cause in fact）是指某一事件在导致原告受伤中起到如此实质性的作用，以至于若无该事件，伤害就不会发生。但在这里，无论该学生的过失是否是其同学受伤的事实原因，该同学都无法胜诉——因为化学实验套装没有缺陷。

（选项 C）对于由极端危险活动造成的损害，可以施加严格责任。尽管制造化学实验套装可能属于极端危险活动，但该同学受伤是由于他试图用化学实验套装制造炸弹，而不是因为化学公司早前制造该套装的行为。因此，根据这一法理，该公司不承担责任。

（选项 D）商业供应商可能因未能就产品的损害风险提供充分警告而承担严格责任——但前提是这些警告本可以防止原告受到伤害。在本案中，该学生和同学已经（从网站上）知道这些化学品可以混合制成爆炸物，并且明知故犯地忽略了这一风险。因此，警告将是无效的，未能警告的诉求也可能会失败。

教学目标：一个产品被认为有设计缺陷，如果 (1) 它造成了可预见的损害风险，并且 (2) 该风险本可以通过一个可行的替代设计来降低，这由风险-效用测试（比较原始设计和替代设计的风险与益处）来确定。

References

Restatement (Third) of Torts: Prods. Liab. §§ 1, 2(b) (Am. Law Inst. 1998) (strict liability for defectively designed products).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Strict Products Liability & Design Defect
正确答案是 选项 B
如果化学实验套装在符合教学目的的前提下已尽可能安全，且其益处超过风险，则不承担责任。
核心考点：设计缺陷

在严格产品责任（Strict Products Liability）诉讼中，原告必须证明产品存在缺陷（Defect）。

对于设计缺陷（Design Defect），法院通常采用风险-效用测试（Risk-Utility Test）：

如果产品的设计风险超过了其效用，或者存在一个合理的替代设计（Reasonable Alternative Design），该替代设计既能降低风险又不会过度损害产品的效用或增加成本，那么该产品即被视为有缺陷。
本案逻辑推演

1. 严格责任的前提：
制造商只对有缺陷的产品承担严格责任。如果产品没有缺陷，无论造成了多大的伤害，制造商都不承担严格责任。

2. 评估本案产品：
化学实验套装的目的是教育。如果移除所有易燃或潜在危险的化学品，可能会使其失去教育价值（Utility）。

3. 结论：
选项 B 正确地指出了辩护理由：如果该套装已经做到了在保留教育功能（Utility）的同时尽可能安全（Risk minimized），那么根据风险-效用测试，它就没有设计缺陷。没有缺陷 = 没有严格责任。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 A (Causation/Negligence):
虽然学生的过失（打翻本生灯）是事实原因，但在严格责任中，第三方的过失并不一定免除制造商的责任（如果是可预见的）。A 错误的原因在于它回避了核心问题——产品本身是否有缺陷。如果产品无缺陷，无需讨论因果关系。
选项 C (Abnormally Dangerous Activity):
这是一个常见的概念混淆。极端危险活动（如爆破、饲养野生动物）适用严格责任，但制造化学套装本身不是极端危险活动。这是产品责任案，不是Rylands v. Fletcher类型的案件。
选项 D (Failure to Warn):
警告缺陷（Failure to Warn）要求证明“如果有警告，伤害就不会发生”。本案中，学生们已经通过网站知道这些化学品可以制造炸弹并具有危险性，但仍故意为之。因此，缺乏警告与伤害之间没有因果关系（Causation fails）。
💡 MBE 提分技巧：
在处理严格产品责任（Strict Products Liability）题目时，永远先问自己：“缺陷在哪里？” (Where is the defect?)
如果是设计缺陷，必须在大脑中进行“风险 vs 收益”的权衡。如果题目设定产品已经“尽可能安全”且“收益大于风险”，那么它就没有缺陷，被告胜诉。

questions.question:
A manufacturing plant located near a busy highway uses and stores highly volatile explosives. The owner of the plant has imposed strict safety measures to prevent an explosion at the plant. During an unusually heavy windstorm, a large tile was blown off the roof of the plant and crashed into a passing car, damaging the hood and the windshield. The driver of the car brought a strict liability action against the owner of the plant to recover for the damage to his car.
Is the driver likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the damage to the car did not result from the abnormally dangerous aspect of the plant's activity.
choices.b: No, because the severity of the windstorm was unusual.
choices.c: Yes, because the plant's activity was abnormally dangerous.
choices.d: Yes, because the plant's location near a busy highway was abnormally dangerous.

Is the driver likely to prevail?

一家位于繁忙高速公路旁的制造工厂，使用并储存着高度易爆的爆炸物。工厂主已采取严格的安全措施以防止工厂发生爆炸。在一场异常猛烈的大风暴中，一块大瓦片从工厂屋顶被吹落，砸中一辆过路汽车，损坏了其引擎盖和挡风玻璃。该车司机对工厂主提起了严格责任诉讼，要求赔偿其汽车的损失。

该司机是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the damage to the car did not result from the abnormally dangerous aspect of the plant's activity.
不会，因为汽车的损害并非由该工厂活动的异常危险方面所导致。

B. No, because the severity of the windstorm was unusual.
不会，因为风暴的猛烈程度是异常的。

C. Yes, because the plant's activity was abnormally dangerous.
会，因为该工厂的活动属于异常危险活动。

D. Yes, because the plant's location near a busy highway was abnormally dangerous.
会，因为该工厂位于繁忙高速公路旁的位置具有异常危险性。
data.explanation:
An abnormally dangerous activity is an uncommon activity that poses a foreseeable and highly significant risk of physical harm - even when reasonable care is used. A defendant is strictly liable (liable without proof of fault) for bodily harm or property damage resulting from the abnormal dangers of that activity.

Here, the manufacturing plant stored highly volatile explosives (uncommon activity) near a busy highway, which created a foreseeable and highly significant risk of a harmful explosion that could not be mitigated by the exercise of reasonable care. However, the damage to the driver's car was caused by a windstorm - a hazard unrelated to the abnormal danger of storing explosives. Therefore, even though the plant engaged in an abnormally dangerous activity (Choice C) , the driver will not prevail on a strict liability claim.

(Choice B) The unusual severity of the windstorm is irrelevant to the driver's strict liability claim. Instead, the driver's claim will fail because the windstorm was unrelated to the danger of storing explosives.

(Choice D) The plant's location near a busy highway increased the abnormal danger of the stored explosives. However, the driver will not prevail because his property damage was not caused by a risk associated with storing explosives.

Educational objective: A defendant is strictly liable for bodily harm or property damage caused by his/her abnormally dangerous activity - not for harm caused by a risk unrelated to the abnormal dangers of the activity.



选项正确率统计：A选项 93%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 3%，D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

异常危险活动 (abnormally dangerous activity) 是一种不常见的活动，即使已采取合理注意，仍会造成可预见且非常重大的身体伤害风险。对于因该活动的异常危险所导致的人身伤害或财产损失，被告需承担严格责任 (strictly liable) （即无需证明其存在过错即可承担的责任）。

在本案中，该制造工厂在繁忙高速公路旁储存高度易爆的爆炸物（不常见的活动），这造成了可预见的、非常重大的有害爆炸风险，且该风险无法通过采取合理注意来减轻。然而，司机汽车的损坏是由风暴造成的——这一风险与储存爆炸物的异常危险无关。因此，尽管该工厂从事了异常危险活动（选项C），该司机也无法在严格责任诉讼中胜诉。

（选项B）风暴的异常猛烈程度与司机的严格责任诉讼无关。司机的诉讼之所以会失败，是因为风暴与储存爆炸物的危险无关。

（选项D）工厂位于繁忙高速公路旁的位置增加了储存爆炸物的异常危险。然而，司机不会胜诉，因为他的财产损失并非由与储存爆炸物相关的风险所导致。

教学目的：被告因其异常危险活动造成的人身伤害或财产损失应承担严格责任——而不是对与该活动的异常危险无关的风险所造成的损害承担责任。

References

  • Restatement (Third) of Torts: Liab. for Physical & Emotional Harm § 20 (Am. Law Inst. 2010) (strict liability for abnormally dangerous activities).
  • Restatement (Third) of Torts: Liab. for Physical & Emotional Harm § 29 cmt. d (Am. Law Inst. 2010) (limitations on strict liability).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Strict Liability & Scope of Risk
⚖️ 核心法律规则 (The Rule) 对于异常危险活动 (Abnormally Dangerous Activities) 的严格责任 (Strict Liability) 并非绝对。责任仅限于该活动特有的异常风险 (Abnormal Risks) 所导致的损害。

Reference: Restatement (Third) of Torts § 29

图示：严格责任的因果关系限制

案例分析

本题考察的是严格责任中的“风险范围” (Scope of Risk) 限制。

虽然储存爆炸物确实属于“异常危险活动”，但这并不意味着工厂主对发生的一切事故都承担严格责任。严格责任只适用于使该活动被认定为“异常危险”的那些特定风险。

  • 爆炸物的特定风险： 爆炸、火灾、有毒气体泄漏。
  • 本案发生的损害： 瓦片被风吹落砸中汽车。

瓦片掉落是任何建筑物（无论是否储存爆炸物）都可能发生的普通风险，它与爆炸物的“易爆性”毫无关系。因此，不能适用严格责任。

选项解析
正确 A 不会，因为汽车的损害并非由该工厂活动的异常危险方面所导致。
这是对法律规则的完美陈述。损害必须源于使活动变得危险的特性（即爆炸风险），而不是附带的普通风险（如瓦片掉落）。
错误 B 风暴的猛烈程度。
这通常涉及“天灾” (Act of God) 抗辩，但在严格责任分析中，首要问题是因果关系是否成立。既然损害类型本身就不在严格责任范围内，风暴是否异常就不是决定性因素。
错误 C 会，因为该工厂的活动属于异常危险活动。
这是典型的“陷阱选项”。考生容易看到“爆炸物”就直接联想“严格责任”，而忽略了因果关系（Causation）的限制。从事危险活动并不意味着成为所有损害的绝对保险人。
错误 D 位置因素。
虽然位置（靠近高速公路）是判断活动是否“异常危险”的因素之一，但它不能弥补因果关系的缺失。损害依然是由瓦片而非爆炸引起的。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 在处理 Strict Liability 题目时，请遵循两步法：
  1. 定性：该活动是否属于异常危险活动？（本题：是）
  2. 定因：损害是否由该活动的核心危险特性导致？（本题：否，瓦片掉落不是爆炸风险）
如果第二步为“否”，则严格责任不成立（尽管被告可能因过失 Negligence 承担责任，但题目问的是严格责任）。

questions.question:
A computer hardware company developed a new, high-speed processor ideal for massive multiplayer online games (MMOGs). The processor produces more heat than average processors, requiring stronger fans. The company installed stronger fans in its desktop computers containing the new processors to cool them after continuous, intense usage. The fans in the company's laptops are sufficient for most usage, but they cannot sufficiently cool the new processor if it is used continuously for hours, which is common when users play MMOGs. In such cases, the processor can overheat, occasionally shorting a circuit. The company determined that it was still reasonable to sell the laptops with the new processor and included a warning about the fans' limitations on each laptop.
The plaintiff purchased a laptop with the new processor to play MMOGs and suffered an electrical burn when the laptop overheated and short-circuited, causing a small electrical fire. The plaintiff sued the company for strict products liability in a jurisdiction that applies the risk-utility test for a design defect. At trial, it was established that installation of the stronger fans in the laptops was possible but that it would add significant weight and cost to the laptops, making them impractical to carry and prohibitively expensive. The additional weight and cost would make the laptops virtually unsellable.
Is the plaintiff likely to prevail in his action against the computer hardware company?

choices.a: No, because installing stronger fans would make the laptops virtually unsellable.
choices.b: No, because the risk of a short circuit is not uncontemplated by an ordinary consumer.
choices.c: Yes, because installing stronger fans was a reasonable alternative design.
choices.d: Yes, because the risk of an electrical fire was unreasonably dangerous.

questions.question:
A consumer bought a kitchen blender from a manufacturer. Soon after the purchase, the consumer was using the blender in an appropriate way when the blender jar shattered, throwing a piece of glass into the consumer's eye.
The consumer brought an action against the manufacturer based solely on strict products liability. The consumer's expert testified that the blender was defectively designed. However, because the blender jar had been destroyed in the accident, the expert could not determine whether the accident had been caused by the design defect or a manufacturing defect. The manufacturer's expert testified that the blender was not defective.
If, at the conclusion of the evidence, both parties move for directed verdicts, how should the trial judge rule?

choices.a: Deny both motions and send the case to the jury, because a jury reasonably could conclude that the harm was caused by a defect present in the product when it was sold.
choices.b: Direct a verdict for the consumer, because the blender was new when the jar shattered, and thus was undeniably defective.
choices.c: Direct a verdict for the manufacturer, because the consumer's action was brought solely on a strict liability theory.
choices.d: Direct a verdict for the manufacturer, because the consumer's expert was unable to specify the nature of the defect.

data.questionStem:
Q83238

A consumer bought a kitchen blender from a manufacturer. Soon after the purchase, the consumer was using the blender in an appropriate way when the blender jar shattered, throwing a piece of glass into the consumer's eye.

The consumer brought an action against the manufacturer based solely on strict products liability. The consumer's expert testified that the blender was defectively designed. However, because the blender jar had been destroyed in the accident, the expert could not determine whether the accident had been caused by the design defect or a manufacturing defect. The manufacturer's expert testified that the blender was not defective.

If, at the conclusion of the evidence, both parties move for directed verdicts, how should the trial judge rule?

一名消费者从制造商处购买了一台厨房搅拌机。购买后不久，当消费者以适当的方式使用搅拌机时，搅拌机容器突然破碎，一块玻璃碎片飞入消费者眼中。

该消费者仅基于严格产品责任（strict products liability）对制造商提起诉讼。消费者的专家作证称，该搅拌机存在设计缺陷。然而，由于搅拌机容器在事故中被毁，专家无法确定事故是由设计缺陷还是制造缺陷造成的。制造商的专家则作证称，该搅拌机没有缺陷。

如果在证据出示完毕时，双方均请求作出指示性裁决（directed verdicts），审判法官应如何裁决？
options:
A. Deny both motions and send the case to the jury, because a jury reasonably could conclude that the harm was caused by a defect present in the product when it was sold.
驳回双方的动议，并将案件交由陪审团审理，因为陪审团可以合理地断定，损害是由产品售出时就存在的缺陷造成的。

B. Direct a verdict for the consumer, because the blender was new when the jar shattered, and thus was undeniably defective.
作出对消费者有利的指示性裁决，因为搅拌机容器破碎时是新的，因此无可否认地存在缺陷。

C. Direct a verdict for the manufacturer, because the consumer's action was brought solely on a strict liability theory.
作出对制造商有利的指示性裁决，因为消费者的诉讼仅基于严格责任理论。

D. Direct a verdict for the manufacturer, because the consumer's expert was unable to specify the nature of the defect.
作出对制造商有利的指示性裁决，因为消费者的专家无法指明缺陷的性质。
data.explanation:
A motion for a directed verdict should be granted if no reasonable jury could find in the nonmovant's favor. For example, a defendant's motion should be granted if there is insufficient evidence to support any element of the plaintiff's claim. Conversely, a plaintiff's motion should be granted if every element of the claim has been established beyond dispute.

A strict products liability claim requires proof of the following elements:
  • The defendant was a commercial seller (eg, manufacturer - as seen here).
  • The product was defective at the time it left the defendant's control.
  • The defect caused the plaintiff physical harm (eg, bodily injury - as seen here).
The trier of fact can infer that the product was defective and caused the plaintiff's harm if that harm (1) is of a kind that ordinarily results from a product defect and (2) was not solely due to other causes. This is true even when the plaintiff lacks direct evidence on these last two elements.

Here, the consumer's expert witness could not specify the nature of the blender's defect. But the jury may infer that the blender was defective when purchased from the manufacturer. That is because (1) a new blender jar typically shatters because of a defect and (2) the consumer's appropriate use soon after the purchase negates other causes. As a result, the judge should deny the manufacturer's motion (Choices C & D).

However, the fact that the blender was new when the jar shattered does not require the jury to conclude that the blender was undeniably defective. The jury may infer that the blender was defective OR rely on the manufacturer's expert testimony and conclude that it was not. Therefore, the judge should deny both motions and send the case to the jury (Choice B).

Educational objective: In a strict products liability action, it can be inferred that a product was defective and caused the plaintiff's harm if that harm is of a kind that ordinarily results from a product defect AND was not solely due to other causes.



选项正确率统计：A选项 80%（正确选项），B选项 13%，C选项 2%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

如果任何理性的陪审团都不可能作出对非动议方有利的裁决，则应批准作出指示性裁决的动议。例如，如果证据不足以支持原告主张的任何要素，则应批准被告的动议。反之，如果原告主张的每一个要素都已毫无争议地成立，则应批准原告的动议。

一项严格产品责任 (strict products liability) 索赔需要证明以下要素：
  • 被告是商业销售者（例如，如此处的制造商）。
  • 产品在脱离被告控制时存在缺陷。
  • 该缺陷对原告造成了身体伤害（例如，如此处的人身伤害）。
如果损害（1）属于通常由产品缺陷导致的类型，且（2）并非完全由其他原因造成，那么事实审理者可以推断产品存在缺陷并对原告造成了损害。即使原告对后两个要素缺乏直接证据，这一推断依然成立。

在本案中，消费者的专家证人无法指明搅拌机缺陷的性质。但陪审团可以推断搅拌机在从制造商处购买时就存在缺陷。这是因为（1）新的搅拌机容器破碎通常是由于缺陷所致，以及（2）消费者在购买后不久的适当使用排除了其他原因。因此，法官应驳回制造商的动议（选项C和D）。

然而，搅拌机容器破碎时是新的这一事实，并不要求陪审团必须断定搅拌机无可否认地存在缺陷。陪审团可以推断搅拌机存在缺陷，也可以采信制造商的专家证词并断定其没有缺陷。因此，法官应驳回双方的动议，并将案件交由陪审团审理（选项B）。

教学目标：在严格产品责任 (strict products liability) 诉讼中，如果损害属于通常由产品缺陷导致的类型，并且并非完全由其他原因造成，则可以推断产品存在缺陷并对原告造成了损害。

References

  • Restatement (Third) of Torts: Prods. Liab. § 1 (Am. Law Inst. 1998) (requirements for strict products liability).
  • Restatement (Third) of Torts: Prods. Liab. § 3 (Am. Law Inst. 1998) (inference of product defect).

MBE 考点解析

Strict Products Liability & Evidence
正确答案：A
驳回双方的动议，将案件交给陪审团。
Deny both motions and send the case to the jury.
核心法律规则：不确定性缺陷理论

本题考察的是严格产品责任中的一个特殊证据规则，通常被称为“故障理论” (Malfunction Theory) 或参考《侵权法重述（第三次）：产品责任》第3条。

规则要点：
即使原告无法证明具体的缺陷性质（设计缺陷 vs. 制造缺陷），如果事实审理者（陪审团）发现以下两点，仍可推断 (Infer) 产品在销售时存在缺陷：
  • 该事故属于通常由产品缺陷导致的类型；且
  • 该事故并非完全由其他原因（如消费者滥用）造成。
深度解析
1. 为什么不能判被告胜诉 (Directed Verdict for Manufacturer)?
虽然原告专家无法确定具体的缺陷类型（因为证据已毁），但原告提供了强有力的间接证据 (Circumstantial Evidence)：
  • 搅拌机是新的 (New product)；
  • 消费者使用方式得当 (Appropriate use)。
在这种情况下，法律允许陪审团进行事实推断：如果没有缺陷，新的搅拌机在正常使用下通常不会爆炸。因此，原告已建立了表面证据确凿的案件 (Prima Facie Case)，法官不能直接判被告胜诉。
2. 为什么不能判原告胜诉 (Directed Verdict for Consumer)?
虽然推断是允许的，但它不是强制性的 (Permissive, not mandatory)。

陪审团有权：
  • 接受推断，认为产品有缺陷；或者
  • 拒绝推断，采信被告专家的证词（即产品没有缺陷）。
既然存在合理的意见分歧，法官必须将决定权交给陪审团，而不能直接判原告胜诉。
选项辨析
选项 A 正确。符合上述逻辑：证据足以让陪审团可能得出结论，但并不强制他们必须得出该结论。

选项 B 错误。即使产品是新的，也不代表“无可否认地 (Undeniably)”存在缺陷。被告有专家作证说无缺陷，这是一个事实争议点 (Issue of Fact)。

选项 C 错误。严格责任理论并不要求必须有直接证据证明具体的缺陷部位，间接证据也可以支持严格责任诉讼。

选项 D 错误。这是本题最大的陷阱。在产品被毁坏的情况下，原告不需要具体指明是“设计缺陷”还是“制造缺陷”，只要证明“某种缺陷”导致了事故即可。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

当看到“产品被毁 (Product destroyed)” + “无法确定具体缺陷 (Cannot specify defect)” 的组合时：
  1. 联想类似 Res Ipsa Loquitur（过失推定）的逻辑，但在产品责任法中，这叫 Indeterminate Defect。
  2. 只要排除了消费者的滥用，且事故本身暗示了故障，原告就能过“送交陪审团 (Get to the jury)”这一关。
  3. Directed Verdict 的标准极高：只有当“没有任何理性的陪审团”会支持对方时，法官才会批准。只要有推断的空间，就选“Deny motions”。

questions.question:
The driver of a newly purchased automobile encountered problems with its power steering. Due to a manufacturing defect in the steering system that was present when the automobile left the manufacturer, the driver was unable to control the automobile. Fortunately, the driver was able to bring the automobile to a stop, but not before hitting and destroying a parked bicycle. Seeking to recover the cost of her bicycle, the bicyclist has sued the automobile manufacturer in a breach-of-warranty action.
Is the bicyclist likely to succeed in a jurisdiction that follows the majority approach to breach-of-warranty actions?

choices.a: No, because the bicyclist did not suffer any personal injuries due to the defective steering system.
choices.b: No, because the bicyclist was not in privity with the automobile manufacturer.
choices.c: Yes, because the defect in the automobile's steering system that destroyed the bicycle existed at the time the automobile left the manufacturer's control.
choices.d: Yes, because the property damage suffered by the bicyclist was a foreseeable result of an automobile with a faulty steering system.

Q83223

The driver of a newly purchased automobile encountered problems with its power steering. Due to a manufacturing defect in the steering system that was present when the automobile left the manufacturer, the driver was unable to control the automobile. Fortunately, the driver was able to bring the automobile to a stop, but not before hitting and destroying a parked bicycle. Seeking to recover the cost of her bicycle, the bicyclist has sued the automobile manufacturer in a breach-of-warranty action.

Is the bicyclist likely to succeed in a jurisdiction that follows the majority approach to breach-of-warranty actions?

一名新购汽车的驾驶员遇到了其动力转向系统的问题。由于该车离开制造商时就存在的转向系统制造缺陷，驾驶员无法控制该汽车。幸运的是，驾驶员最终将汽车停了下来，但在此之前撞毁了一辆停放的自行车。为了追回其自行车的费用，自行车主以违反担保为由，对汽车制造商提起了诉讼。

在一个遵循违反担保之诉主流方法的司法管辖区内，自行车主是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the bicyclist did not suffer any personal injuries due to the defective steering system.
不会，因为自行车主没有因有缺陷的转向系统而遭受任何人身伤害。

B. No, because the bicyclist was not the purchaser of the automobile sold by the dealer.
不会，因为自行车主不是经销商所售汽车的购买者。

C. Yes, because the defect in the automobile's steering system that destroyed the bicycle existed at the time the automobile left the manufacturer's control.
会，因为摧毁自行车的汽车转向系统缺陷在该汽车离开制造商控制时就已经存在。

D. Yes, because the property damage suffered by the bicyclist was a foreseeable result of an automobile with a faulty steering system.
会，因为自行车主所遭受的财产损害是一辆有故障转向系统的汽车所导致的可预见结果。
data.explanation:
Products liability actions based on breach of warranty can be asserted against a variety of defendants (eg, retailers, distributors, manufacturers). However, the plaintiff must establish privity with the defendant to have standing to sue for breach of warranty. This becomes an issue when the plaintiff is someone other than the purchaser. Under the majority approach, the purchaser's privity extends only to members of the purchaser's family or household - but they can only recover for personal injury.

Here, the driver (not the bicyclist) was the purchaser of the automobile, and the bicyclist is not a member of the driver's family or household. This means that the bicyclist is not in privity with the automobile manufacturer under the majority approach and has no standing to sue. As a result, her breach-of-warranty action against the manufacturer will not succeed.†

†Had this jurisdiction followed a minority approach - under which privity extends to any person reasonably expected to use, consume, or be affected by the product - the bicyclist would have had standing and could have recovered for any injury.

(Choice A) Whether the bicyclist suffered any personal injuries would matter only if she were in privity with the manufacturer and had standing to sue. But even if she had standing, the bicyclist could not recover because she only sustained property damage - not personal injury.

(Choice C) Because the steering system defect existed when the automobile left the manufacturer's control, the manufacturer is a proper defendant. But the bicyclist is not a proper plaintiff because she is not in privity with the manufacturer and therefore lacks standing to sue.

(Choice D) A strict products liability action can be brought by anyone foreseeably injured by a defective product or whose property is harmed by the product. But the foreseeability of the property damage suffered by the bicyclist is not a reason for her to prevail in this breach-of-warranty action.

Educational objective: Under the majority approach, members of a purchaser's family or household have standing to sue for breach of a product warranty, but they can only recover for personal injury.



选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 34%（正确选项），C选项 27%，D选项 31%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

基于违反担保的产品责任之诉可以向多种被告（例如，零售商、分销商、制造商）提起。然而，原告必须证明与被告之间存在合同相对性（privity with the defendant），才拥有起诉资格（standing to sue）以提起违反担保（breach of warranty）之诉。当原告非购买者时，这就成了一个问题。根据多数派方法，购买者的合同相对性仅延伸至购买者的家人或家庭成员——但他们只能就人身伤害获得赔偿。

在本案中，驾驶员（而非自行车主）是汽车的购买者，而自行车主不是驾驶员的家人或家庭成员。这意味着，根据多数派方法，自行车主与汽车制造商之间不存在合同相对性，因此没有起诉资格。因此，她对制造商提起的违反担保之诉将不会成功。†

†如果该司法管辖区遵循少数派方法——即合同相对性延伸至任何可合理预期会使用、消费或受产品影响的人——那么自行车主将拥有起诉资格，并可就任何损害获得赔偿。

(选项A) 自行车主是否遭受任何人身伤害，只有在她与制造商存在合同相对性并拥有起诉资格的情况下才重要。但即使她有起诉资格，自行车主也无法获得赔偿，因为她只遭受了财产损害——而非人身伤害。

(选项C) 因为转向系统缺陷在汽车离开制造商控制时就已存在，所以制造商是适格的被告。但自行车主不是适格的原告，因为她与制造商之间没有合同相对性，因此缺乏起诉资格。

(选项D) 严格产品责任之诉可由任何因缺陷产品而受到可预见伤害的人，或其财产因此受损的人提起。但是，自行车主所遭受的财产损害的可预见性，并不能成为她在这起违反担保之诉中胜诉的理由。

教学目标：根据多数派方法，购买者的家人或家庭成员拥有就违反产品担保提起诉讼的资格，但他们只能就人身伤害获得赔偿。

References

U.C.C. § 2-318 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (extended privity for breach-of-warranty actions).

MBE 考点解析

Strict Liability & Products Liability

UCC Article 2 Breach of Warranty

本题考察的是产品责任法中关于违反担保（Breach of Warranty）诉讼的一个核心限制：合同相对性（Privity）。

⚖️ 核心法律规则

在基于违反担保（Breach of Warranty）的产品责任诉讼中，原告必须证明其拥有起诉资格（Standing）。

根据《统一商法典》（UCC § 2-318）的多数派方法（Alternative A）：

  • 水平相对性（Horizontal Privity）仅延伸至买方的家庭成员（Family）、同住人员（Household）或客人（Guests）。
  • 且通常仅限于人身伤害（Personal Injury）的赔偿。
🔍 案情分析

原告身份：路过的自行车主（Bicyclist）。
被告身份：汽车制造商。
诉由：违反担保（Breach of Warranty）。

在本案中，自行车主既不是汽车的购买者，也不是购买者的家人或同住人员。她是一个纯粹的旁观者（Bystander）。

在一个遵循“多数派方法”的司法管辖区，旁观者与制造商之间不存在合同相对性（Privity of Contract）。因此，自行车主没有资格以“违反担保”为由起诉。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 B)

选项 B 正确。因为它指出了自行车主败诉的根本原因：缺乏合同相对性（Lack of Privity）。

虽然制造商确实生产了有缺陷的产品，但违反担保之诉本质上源于合同法。多数派规则（UCC § 2-318 Alt A）严格限制了谁可以作为第三方受益人起诉。由于自行车主不是买方及其家庭圈子内的人，她被排除在担保保护之外。

🚫 常见误区与陷阱

陷阱 1：混淆“侵权”与“担保” (选项 D)

⚠️ 关键区别：如果本题是严格侵权责任（Strict Liability in Tort）诉讼，那么选项 D 的逻辑（可预见性）是正确的，旁观者可以胜诉。

但在违反担保（Breach of Warranty）诉讼中，合同相对性是必须跨越的门槛，单纯的“可预见性”不足以建立起诉资格。

陷阱 2：关注损害类型而非资格 (选项 A)

虽然多数派规则通常只涵盖人身伤害，但选项 A 错误地暗示如果有人身伤害她就能赢。事实上，即使她受了伤，由于她缺乏合同相对性（不是家人/同住者），她依然无法起诉。

📚 总结：MBE 解题技巧
诉讼理论 原告资格要求
Strict Liability (Tort)
严格侵权责任		 任何可预见的原告（包括旁观者）。无需合同关系。
Breach of Warranty
违反担保 (UCC)		 受 Privity 限制。多数派仅限买方及其家人/同住者。

💡 考试时请务必看清题目问的是 "Strict Liability" 还是 "Breach of Warranty"。

questions.question:
A company manufactured metal stamping presses that were usually sold with an installed safety device that made it impossible for a press to close on a worker's hands. The company strongly recommended that its presses be purchased with the safety device installed, but would sell a press without the safety device at a slightly reduced price.
Rejecting the company's advice, a worker's employer purchased a stamping press without the safety device. The press closed on the worker's hand, crushing it.
If the worker were to sue the company, would the worker be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the company strongly recommended that the worker's employer purchase the press with the safety device.
choices.b: No, because the failure of the worker's employer to purchase the press with a safety device was a superseding cause of the worker's injury.
choices.c: Yes, because the company sold the press to the worker's employer without an installed safety device.
choices.d: Yes, because the company's press was the cause in fact of the worker's injury.

data.questionStem:
Q83231

A company manufactured metal stamping presses that were usually sold with an installed safety device that made it impossible for a press to close on a worker's hands. The company strongly recommended that its presses be purchased with the safety device installed, but would sell a press without the safety device at a slightly reduced price.

Rejecting the company's advice, a worker's employer purchased a stamping press without the safety device. The press closed on the worker's hand, crushing it.

If the worker were to sue the company, would the worker be likely to prevail?

一家公司生产金属冲压机，这些冲压机通常会安装一种安全装置一同出售，该装置可以防止冲压机压到工人的手。公司强烈建议购买安装了安全装置的冲压机，但也会以稍低的价格出售不带安全装置的冲压机。

一名工人的雇主未采纳公司的建议，购买了一台没有安全装置的冲压机。冲压机压伤了该工人的手。

如果该工人起诉该公司，他是否有可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the company strongly recommended that the worker's employer purchase the press with the safety device.
不会，因为公司强烈建议该工人的雇主购买带有安全装置的冲压机。

B. No, because the failure of the worker's employer to purchase the press with a safety device was a superseding cause of the worker's injury.
不会，因为该工人的雇主未能购买带有安全装置的冲压机，是导致该工人受伤的介入性独立原因 (superseding cause)。

C. Yes, because the company sold the press to the worker's employer without an installed safety device.
会，因为该公司向工人的雇主出售了未安装安全装置的冲压机。

D. Yes, because the company's press was the cause in fact of the worker's injury.
会，因为该公司的冲压机是造成该工人伤害的事实原因 (cause in fact)。
data.explanation:
Types of product defects


Manufacturing defectDeviation from intended design (eg, incorrect assembly)
Design defectForeseeable risk of harm that could have been mitigated by feasible alternative design (ie, reasonable in cost)
Inadequate warningNo reasonable instructions or warnings about risks of harm
Strict products liability is imposed on a commercial seller (eg, manufacturer, wholesaler, retailer) when its defective product causes the plaintiff harm. A product is defective by design when:

the design creates a foreseeable risk of physical harm and that risk could have been mitigated by a reasonable alternative design (eg, a modification that reduces the risk for a reasonable cost).

Here, the company's metal stamping presses posed a foreseeable risk of closing on a worker's hands. As a result, the company usually sold its presses with a pre-installed safety device that eliminated the risk of harm for a slightly increased cost (reasonable alternative design). But since the company still sold presses without the safety device (defective design) and that defect caused the press to crush the worker's hand, the company is strictly liable for the worker's harm.

(Choice A) When a manufacturer has a reasonable alternative design, it cannot avoid strict liability by merely warning the purchaser of the product's danger. Therefore, the company's recommendation that customers purchase presses with the safety device installed does not extinguish its strict liability for selling presses without the safety device.

(Choice B) A superseding cause is an unforeseeable intervening act or force that breaks the chain of causation between the defendant's tortious conduct and the plaintiff's harm. Here, since presses were sold without the safety device, it was foreseeable that the worker's employer might purchase one without the device. Therefore, the company's purchase was not a superseding cause.

(Choice D) Although a plaintiff must prove that a product was the cause of his/her injury to prevail on a strict products liability claim, the plaintiff must also prove that the product was defective.

Educational objective: Strict products liability is imposed on a commercial seller whose defective product caused the plaintiff harm. A product is defective by design if (1) the design creates a foreseeable risk of physical harm and (2) that risk could have been mitigated by a reasonable alternative design (a safer design available at a reasonable cost).

选项正确率统计：A选项 19%，B选项 18%，C选项 49%（正确选项），D选项 11%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

产品缺陷的类型


制造缺陷偏离预期设计（例如，不正确的组装）
设计缺陷可通过可行的替代设计（即，成本合理的）来减轻的可预见伤害风险
警示不充分没有关于伤害风险的合理说明或警告
当商业销售者（例如，制造商、批发商、零售商）的有缺陷产品对原告造成伤害时，该销售者应承担Strict products liability。一个产品存在设计缺陷，当：

该设计造成了可预见的人身伤害风险，并且该风险本可以通过合理的替代设计（例如，以合理成本降低风险的修改方案）来减轻。

在本案中，该公司的金属冲压机存在压到工人的手的可预见风险。因此，该公司通常以稍高的成本出售预装安全装置的冲压机，从而消除了伤害风险（合理的替代设计）。但由于该公司仍然出售没有安全装置的冲压机（设计缺陷），且该缺陷导致冲压机压伤了工人的手，因此该公司对工人的伤害承担严格责任。

(选项 A) 当制造商有合理的替代设计时，其不能仅通过警告购买者产品存在危险来规避严格责任。因此，该公司建议客户购买安装了安全装置的冲压机，并不能免除其因出售没有安全装置的冲压机而应承担的严格责任。

(选项 B) 介入性独立原因 (superseding cause) 是一种不可预见的介入行为或力量，它切断了被告的侵权行为与原告所受伤害之间的因果关系链。在本案中，由于冲压机在出售时没有安全装置，因此工人的雇主可能会购买没有该装置的冲压机是可预见的。因此，雇主的购买行为不构成介入性独立原因。

(选项 D) 尽管在 strict products liability 索赔中，原告必须证明产品是其受伤的原因才能胜诉，但原告还必须证明产品存在缺陷。

教学目标：当商业销售者的缺陷产品对原告造成伤害时，该销售者应承担 Strict products liability。一个产品在设计上存在缺陷，如果 (1) 该设计造成了可预见的人身伤害风险，并且 (2) 该风险本可以通过合理的替代设计（以合理成本可获得的更安全的设计）来减轻。

References

Restatement (Third) of Torts: Prods. Liab. §§ 1, 2(b) (Am. Law Inst. 1998) (liability for defectively designed products).

MBE 考点解析

Strict Products Liability & Design Defect

📚 核心法律原则

在严格产品责任 (Strict Products Liability) 下，如果产品存在设计缺陷 (Design Defect)，制造商必须承担责任。

判断设计缺陷的关键标准是：是否存在合理的替代设计 (Reasonable Alternative Design, RAD)。

现有设计
无安全装置，有致伤风险
⬇
替代设计 (RAD)
安装安全装置，成本仅略高
⬇
结论
未采用RAD = 产品有缺陷 (Defective)

⚖️ 案情深度解析

本题考察的是著名的“可选安全装置” (Optional Safety Device) 问题。

虽然制造商“强烈建议”购买安全装置，但它仍然将没有安全装置的冲压机投入了市场。根据 Restatement (Third) of Torts：

  • 如果通过采用合理的替代设计（即安装安全装置），可以减少或避免可预见的伤害风险；且
  • 不采用该替代设计导致产品不安全；

那么该产品就是有缺陷的。

关键点：制造商不能通过让买家“选择”是否要安全装置，来推卸其提供安全产品的不可转让义务 (Non-delegable duty)。

🔍 选项分析

选项 C (正确)

理由：公司出售了未安装安全装置的冲压机。由于存在经济上可行且技术上成熟的安全装置（合理的替代设计），出售不带该装置的产品构成了设计缺陷。在严格责任下，无论制造商是否发出警告或建议，只要产品有缺陷并造成伤害，制造商就需负责。

选项 A (错误)

陷阱：警告/建议免责。
仅仅给出警告或建议（"Strongly recommended"）不能免除设计缺陷的责任。如果可以通过设计（安装装置）来消除危险，制造商必须这样做，而不能仅依靠警告。

选项 B (错误)

陷阱：介入原因 (Superseding Cause)。
雇主为了省钱不买安全装置是完全可预见的 (Foreseeable)。在侵权法中，可预见的第三方过失（雇主的行为）不会切断因果链，因此不是介入性独立原因。

选项 D (错误)

陷阱：事实原因 (Cause in Fact)。
虽然产品确实是伤害的事实原因，但这还不够。严格责任要求证明产品有缺陷 (Defective)。选项D只提到了因果关系，忽略了责任的核心——缺陷的存在。

💡 MBE 提分技巧

遇到工业设备伤害的题目，如果制造商提供了“安全版”和“廉价不安全版”供买家选择：

法院通常认为制造商有责任只销售安全版。不能把“制造安全产品”的责任转嫁给想省钱的雇主。

questions.question:
Toxic materials being transported by truck from a manufacturer's plant to a warehouse leaked from the truck onto the street a few miles from the plant. A driver lost control of his car when he hit the puddle of spilled toxic materials on the street, and he was injured when his car hit a stop sign.
In an action for damages by the driver against the manufacturer based on strict liability, is the driver likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the driver's injury did not result from the toxicity of the materials.
choices.b: No, because the driver's loss of control was an intervening cause.
choices.c: Yes, because the leak occurred near the manufacturer's plant.
choices.d: Yes, because the manufacturer is strictly liable for leaks of its toxic materials.

Q83232

Toxic materials being transported by truck from a manufacturer's plant to a warehouse leaked from the truck onto the street a few miles from the plant. A driver lost control of his car when he hit the puddle of spilled toxic materials on the street, and he was injured when his car hit a stop sign.

In an action for damages by the driver against the manufacturer based on strict liability, is the driver likely to prevail?

一批通过卡车从制造商工厂运往仓库的有毒材料，在距离工厂几英里外的街道上从卡车发生泄漏。一名司机驾车撞上街道上泄漏的有毒材料形成的液滩时，车辆失控，并在其车辆撞上一个停车标志时受伤。

在该司机以严格责任为由对制造商提起的损害赔偿诉讼中，该司机是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the driver's injury did not result from the toxicity of the materials.
不会，因为该司机的伤害并非由这些材料的毒性所致。

B. No, because the driver's loss of control was an intervening cause.
不会，因为该司机的车辆失控是一个介入原因。

C. Yes, because the leak occurred near the manufacturer's plant.
会，因为泄漏发生在制造商工厂附近。

D. Yes, because the manufacturer is strictly liable for leaks of its toxic materials.
会，因为制造商对其有毒材料的泄漏负有严格责任。
data.explanation:
Common examples of abnormally dangerous activities

  • Transporting & storing hazardous materials & gasoline
  • Fumigating & crop dusting with toxic chemicals
  • Storing explosives & blasting
  • Operating nuclear facility
  • Burning fields


A defendant is strictly liable - liable regardless of fault - for harm caused by an abnormally dangerous activity. An activity is abnormally dangerous if it is (1) uncommon in the community and (2) poses a foreseeable and highly significant risk of physical harm to the plaintiff that cannot be mitigated by reasonable care. However, the defendant is only strictly liable for harm that stems from the abnormally dangerous characteristic of that activity.

Here, the transportation of toxic materials (uncommon activity in the community) is an abnormally dangerous activity since persons exposed to the materials have a high probability of becoming seriously ill (foreseeable and significant risk of harm). However, the manufacturer is not strictly liable to the driver since the driver's injury resulted from the puddle of spilled materials - not the materials' abnormally dangerous toxicity. Therefore, the driver's strict liability claim against the manufacturer will likely fail (Choice D).

(Choice B) Only an unforeseeable intervening cause will negate the defendant's strict liability. Here, however, it was foreseeable that a person driving over spilled toxic materials would lose control of the vehicle, so the driver's loss of control will not negate the manufacturer's liability.

(Choice C) A defendant is strictly liable for harm resulting from his/her abnormally dangerous activity regardless of where the harm occurs. Therefore, the location of the leak is irrelevant.

Educational objective: A defendant engaged in an abnormally dangerous activity is strictly liable for harm resulting from the abnormally dangerous characteristic of that activity - eg, illness caused by exposure to spilled toxic chemical, but not injury from a car accident caused by spilled chemicals.

选项正确率统计：A选项 72%（正确选项），B选项 0%，C选项 0%，D选项 26%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

异常危险活动的常见例子

  • 运输和储存危险材料及汽油
  • 使用有毒化学品进行熏蒸和农作物喷洒
  • 储存爆炸物及进行爆破
  • 运营核设施
  • 焚烧田地


被告对因异常危险活动造成的损害负有严格责任（strict liability）——即无论其是否存在过错。一项活动如果（1）在社区中不常见，并且（2）对原告构成一种通过合理注意也无法减轻的、可预见的且高度重大的人身伤害风险，则该活动属于异常危险活动。然而，被告仅对源于该活动之异常危险特性所造成的损害负有严格责任。

在本案中，运输有毒材料（社区中的不常见活动）是一项异常危险活动，因为接触到这些材料的人有很大概率会患上重病（可预见且重大的伤害风险）。然而，制造商对该司机不负有严格责任，因为司机的伤害是由于泄漏材料形成的液滩所致——而非材料本身的异常危险的毒性。因此，该司机对制造商提起的严格责任主张很可能会失败（选项D）。

（选项B） 只有不可预见的介入原因才能免除被告的严格责任。然而，在本案中，一个人驾车驶过泄漏的有毒材料时会失控是可预见的，因此司机的失控行为不会免除制造商的责任。

（选项C） 被告应对其异常危险活动所造成的损害负有严格责任，无论损害发生在何处。因此，泄漏的地点是无关紧要的。

教学目标： 从事异常危险活动的被告，仅对源于该活动之异常危险特性所造成的损害负有严格责任——例如，因接触泄漏的有毒化学品而导致的疾病，而非因泄漏化学品引发的交通事故所造成的伤害。

References

  • Restatement (Third) of Torts: Liab. for Physical & Emotional Harm § 20 (Am. Law Inst. 2010) (abnormally dangerous activity).
  • Restatement (Third) of Torts: Liab. for Physical & Emotional Harm § 29 cmt. l (Am. Law Inst. 2010) (limitations on tortious conduct).

MBE 考点解析

Strict Liability & Scope of Risk
⚖️ 核心法律规则

异常危险活动 (Abnormally Dangerous Activities) 的严格责任有一个关键限制：

被告仅对源于该活动“异常危险特性”所造成的损害承担严格责任。
Defendant is strictly liable only for harm that flows from the abnormally dangerous characteristic of the activity.

参考：Restatement (Third) of Torts § 29

🔍 案情逻辑分析
🚛 活动：运输有毒材料
↓
⚠️ 危险特性：毒性 (Toxicity)
↓
💧 实际事故：滑倒 (Slipping)
↓
❌ 结论：不适用严格责任

虽然运输有毒物质是异常危险活动，但其“异常危险”在于它有毒（会让人中毒、灼伤），而不是在于它是液体（会让人滑倒）。

✅ 为什么选 A？

选项 A 正确。
因为司机的伤害并非由材料的毒性 (Toxicity) 导致。

如果是运输牛奶或水泄漏导致路面湿滑，结果也是一样的（车祸）。因此，这次事故并非源于该活动区别于普通活动的“异常危险”特性。对于这种普通风险（路面湿滑），原告应主张过失 (Negligence)，而非严格责任。

🚫 避坑指南
选项 B (介入原因) 错误：
只有不可预见 (Unforeseeable) 的介入原因才能切断责任。在湿滑路面上失控是完全可预见的，所以这本身不是免责理由。
选项 D (绝对责任) 错误：
这是典型的“诱导性选项”。虽然制造商对泄漏负有责任，但严格责任不是绝对责任 (Absolute Liability)。它受到“风险范围规则” (Scope of Risk Rule) 的限制。
💡 MBE 实战技巧

遇到 Strict Liability 题目时，请按以下两步走：

  1. 定性：这是异常危险活动吗？（本题：是）
  2. 匹配：发生的伤害是否正是让该活动变得“异常危险”的那种伤害？（本题：否，滑倒 vs 中毒）

如果第2步不匹配，严格责任不成立。

© MBE Study Guide | Torts Section

questions.question:
A homeowner hired an arsonist to set fire to the homeowner's house so that the homeowner could collect the insurance proceeds from the fire. After pouring gasoline around the house, the arsonist lit the fire with his cigarette lighter and then put the lighter in his pocket. As the arsonist was standing back admiring his work, the lighter exploded in his pocket. The arsonist suffered severe burns to his leg.
The arsonist brought an action against the manufacturer of the lighter based on strict products liability. Under applicable law, the rules of pure comparative fault apply in such actions.
Will the arsonist prevail?

choices.a: No, because the arsonist was injured in the course of committing a felony by the device used to perpetrate the felony.
choices.b: No, because the lighter was not being used for an intended or reasonably foreseeable purpose.
choices.c: Yes, if the arsonist can establish that the lighter was the proximate cause of his injury.
choices.d: Yes, if the lighter exploded because of a defect caused by a manufacturing error.

A homeowner hired an arsonist to set fire to the homeowner's house so that the homeowner could collect the insurance proceeds from the fire. After pouring gasoline around the house, the arsonist lit the fire with his cigarette lighter and then put the lighter in his pocket. As the arsonist was standing back admiring his work, the lighter exploded in his pocket. The arsonist suffered severe burns to his leg.

The arsonist brought an action against the manufacturer of the lighter based on strict products liability. Under applicable law, the rules of pure comparative fault apply in such actions.

Will the arsonist prevail?

一名房主雇佣了一名纵火犯，放火焚烧自己的房屋，以便骗取火灾保险金。纵火犯在房屋周围泼洒汽油后，用他的打火机点燃了火，然后将打火机放入口袋。正当纵火犯退后欣赏他的“杰作”时，他口袋里的打火机爆炸了。纵火犯的腿部被严重烧伤。

纵火犯基于严格产品责任对打火机制造商提起了诉讼。根据适用法律，纯粹比较过错规则适用于此类诉讼。

纵火犯会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the arsonist was injured in the course of committing a felony by the device used to perpetrate the felony.
不会，因为纵火犯是在实施重罪的过程中，被用于实施该重罪的工具所伤。

B. No, because the lighter was not being used for an intended or reasonably foreseeable purpose.
不会，因为该打火机的使用并非为了其预定或可合理预见的目的。

C. Yes, if the arsonist can establish that the lighter was the proximate cause of his injury.
会，如果纵火犯能够证实打火机是其受伤的近因。

D. Yes, if the lighter exploded because of a defect caused by a manufacturing error.
会，如果打火机爆炸是由于制造错误导致的缺陷所致。
data.explanation:
To prevail in an action based on strict products liability, the plaintiff must prove that the defendant is a commercial supplier - one engaged in the business of manufacturing, distributing, or selling products - who produced or sold a defective product that caused the plaintiff harm. A product is defective if a manufacturing error caused the product to deviate from its intended design despite the manufacturer's exercise of all possible care.

Here, the cigarette lighter exploded in the arsonist's pocket and caused him severe burns. If that explosion resulted from a manufacturing error that made the lighter deviate from its intended design, then the manufacturer will be strictly liable for the arsonist's harm.

(Choices A & B) A commercial supplier is strictly liable for harm caused by a defective product used in a foreseeable manner. Therefore, a plaintiff's misuse of a product - using the product in an unintended and unforeseeable manner - negates a commercial supplier's strict liability.

Here, the arsonist will prevail because the lighter exploded while he stored it in his pocket (foreseeable use) - not while he was using it to perpetrate a felony (misuse).

(Choice C) Commercial suppliers are only strictly liable for harm proximately caused by the product's manufacturing error. Therefore, mere evidence that the lighter - not a manufacturing error in the lighter - proximately caused the arsonist's injury is insufficient to establish strict products liability.

Educational objective: A commercial supplier is strictly liable for harm caused by a manufacturing defect - a deviation from the product's intended design despite the manufacturer's exercise of all possible care.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 9%，C选项 12%，D选项 72%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在基于严格产品责任（strict products liability）的诉讼中要胜诉，原告必须证明被告是商业供应商（commercial supplier）——即从事制造、分销或销售产品业务的实体——其生产或销售了对原告造成损害的有缺陷的产品（defective product）。如果一个产品因制造错误导致其偏离预定设计（deviate from its intended design），即使制造商已尽到所有可能的注意义务，该产品仍被视为有缺陷。

在本案中，打火机在纵火犯的口袋里爆炸，导致其严重烧伤。如果爆炸是由于制造错误导致打火机偏离其预定设计，那么制造商将对纵火犯的损害承担严格责任。

(选项 A & B) 商业供应商对以可预见的方式使用的缺陷产品所造成的损害承担严格责任。因此，原告对产品的误用——即以非预定且不可预见的方式使用产品——会使商业供应商的严格责任失效。

在本案中，纵火犯将会胜诉，因为打火机是在他将其存放在口袋中时（可预见的用途）爆炸的，而不是在他用它来实施重罪时（误用）。

(选项 C) 商业供应商仅对由产品的制造错误所近因造成的损害承担严格责任。因此，仅凭打火机——而非打火机的制造错误——是纵火犯受伤的近因这一证据，不足以确立严格产品责任。

教学目标：商业供应商对由制造缺陷造成的损害承担严格责任——即尽管制造商已尽到所有可能的注意义务，产品仍偏离其预定设计。

References

Restatement (Third) of Torts: Prods. Liab. § 1 (Am. Law Inst. 1998) (liability of commercial supplier).

Restatement (Third) of Torts: Prods. Liab. § 2(a) (Am. Law Inst. 1998) (manufacturing defect).

MBE 考点解析

Strict Products Liability & Torts

✅ 为什么选 D？

本题的核心在于制造缺陷 (Manufacturing Defect) 的定义。

在严格产品责任 (Strict Products Liability) 下，原告只需证明：

  • 被告是商业供应商 (Commercial Supplier)；
  • 产品存在缺陷 (Defect)；
  • 该缺陷是造成伤害的实际原因和近因 (Actual and Proximate Cause)；
  • 存在损害。

选项 D 指出打火机爆炸是因为“制造错误导致的缺陷”。如果产品因为制造过程中的错误而偏离了其预定设计 (Deviate from intended design)，即使制造商尽到了所有可能的注意义务，它仍然被视为有缺陷。这是严格责任的基础，因此原告会胜诉。

⚠️ 常见的思维陷阱

陷阱 1：原告是坏人 (The "Bad Guy" Plaintiff)

很多考生看到原告是纵火犯 (Arsonist)，第一反应是“法律不保护罪犯”（选项 A）。

法律解析：虽然原告在犯罪，但伤害并非直接源于犯罪行为本身的风险（如被自己放的火烧伤），而是源于产品在可预见的使用 (Foreseeable Use) 过程中发生的爆炸。将打火机放入口袋是完全可预见的行为，与他是否刚放完火无关。

陷阱 2：因果关系 vs. 缺陷 (Causation vs. Defect)

选项 C 看起来很有道理（近因），但它忽略了严格责任的前提：产品必须有缺陷。

如果打火机没有缺陷，仅仅是作为点火工具导致了伤害（例如手指碰到火苗），制造商是不负责任的。必须证明是“缺陷”导致了伤害，而不仅仅是“产品”导致了伤害。

🎓 MBE 实战技巧

1. 区分“制造缺陷”与“设计缺陷”：
本题描述的是单个产品发生爆炸，偏离了正常标准，这是典型的制造缺陷 (Manufacturing Defect)。对于此类缺陷，适用严格责任规则最直接。

2. 不要对原告进行道德审判：
MBE 经常设置“不受欢迎的原告”（如罪犯、酒鬼）。除非题目涉及具体的抗辩理由（如 Assumption of Risk 或特定的非法行为抗辩），否则应专注于侵权法的构成要件 (Elements of the Tort)。

3. 关注“可预见性” (Foreseeability)：
制造商对产品的“误用” (Misuse) 不负责任，但前提是这种误用是不可预见的。将打火机放入口袋，即使是在犯罪后，也是产品的常规、可预见用途。

In preparation for a mountain-climbing expedition, a climber purchased the necessary climbing equipment from a retailer in sporting goods. A week later, the climber fell from a rock face when a safety device he had purchased from the retailer malfunctioned because of a defect in its manufacture. Thereafter, a paramedic was severely injured when he tried to reach and give assistance to the climber on the ledge to which the climber had fallen. The paramedic's injury was not caused by any fault on his own part. This jurisdiction does not recognize the firefighter's rule in products liability actions.
If the paramedic brings an action against the retailer to recover damages for his injuries, will the paramedic prevail?

choices.a: No, because the paramedic did not rely on the representation of safety implied from the sale of the safety device by the retailer.
choices.b: No, unless the retailer could have discovered the defect by a reasonable inspection of the safety device.
choices.c: Yes, because injury to a person in the paramedic's position was foreseeable if the safety device failed.
choices.d: Yes, unless the climber was negligent in failing to test the safety device.
